steps.instruction: Create only crm_store.py now. Define class Store: __init__(path) connects sqlite3 to self.connection, row_factory sqlite3.Row; create tables customers(id integer primary key,name text,email text), quotes(id integer primary key,customer_id integer,description text,total_cents integer), events(id integer primary key,title text,starts_at text), email_drafts(id integer primary key,customer_id integer,subject text,body text). All writes commit. close() closes connection. _rows(sql,params=()) returns list[dict]. _insert(sql,params) executes parameterized INSERT, commits, returns integer lastrowid. _customer(customer_id) raises ValueError if no such customers.id. Keep this complete module concise, below 3000 characters. Other public CRM methods will be implemented in later modules; do not implement them here. Return action continue. Do not create tests or README yet.

Create only tests/test_store.py. Test the existing Store class in crm_store with pytest and tmp_path: insert a customer via _insert with SQL parameters, close and reopen the database, verify _rows returns the exact persisted Unicode/apostrophe name and integer id. Verify _customer on an absent id raises ValueError. No fake tests, no conftest or configuration. Keep below 2000 characters. Store is currently the only implemented module; public CRM features follow in subsequent stages. Return continue. Import Store with from crm_store import Store; do not import crm because the facade is not implemented yet.

Create only crm_people.py. Define class People mixin, using Store helpers self._rows, self._insert and self._customer already in the snapshot. Implement add_customer(name,email) rejecting blank names, list_customers(), add_quote(customer_id,description,total_cents) rejecting negative amounts and absent customers, list_quotes(customer_id). Use exact schema and public return contract. No constructor; no class import needed for the mixin. Concise complete module below 3000 characters. Return continue.

Create only crm_work.py. Define class Work mixin, using Store helpers self._rows, self._insert and self._customer. Implement add_event(title,starts_at), list_events(), draft_email(customer_id,subject,body), list_email_drafts(customer_id). Drafts must validate customer presence. Preserve strings exactly. No network or email sending. No constructor. Concise complete module below 3000 characters. Return continue.

Create only crm.py as the public facade. Import Store from crm_store, People from crm_people, Work from crm_work. Define CRM(People, Work, Store), inheriting methods and Store constructor. Do not duplicate implementation. Keep below 700 characters, return continue.

Create only tests/test_crm.py with real pytest tests using from crm import CRM and tmp_path. Cover customer persistence after close/reopen, quote validation, calendar persistence and persistent email drafts. No conftest, external dependencies or test configuration. Concise complete tests below 3000 characters; return continue.

Create only README.md. Document Python 3.12 and standard-library-only CRM use, pytest for tests, SQLite persistence, API usage example and limitations: library only, calendar records only, email drafts never sent. Run instructions python -m pytest -q. Return complete only if existing application tests pass. Keep below 1800 characters and preserve existing files, plan and runtime.
